title: asset.created
description: An asset was created (censhare AssetEvent/checkin-new). Source censhare.server (docs/EVENTS.md).

version.description: The detail's schema version. Raised only for a change a subscriber could break on; a new member is not one.

assetVersion.description: The asset version the event is about.

userId.description: censhare party id of the user whose action raised the event, when censhare records one.

serviceIdentity.description: When the user is an automation's own censhare person (id_extern cognito:<client id>): its Cognito app client id. Absent for a person.

name.description: Asset name, read when the event was published.

type.description: censhare asset type, e.g. picture., text., product.item.

correlationId.description: The X-Ray trace id the server gave the event when it published it (#1088). EventBridge passes it on to the run the event starts, and the server log line for the event names it too.
